title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Intern
company_overview: We engineer robust cloud platforms, automated deployment pipelines, and global infrastructure that keep our multi-tenant SaaS services running 24/7/365.
responsibilities: Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates in Terraform for AWS/GCP cloud environments.
Build and improve automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Docker.
Configure monitoring alerts, log aggregation, and Grafana observability dashboards.
Assist senior SREs with incident response postmortems and chaos engineering experiments.
required_skills: Familiarity with Linux operating system fundamentals, shell scripting (Bash), and system commands.
Foundational understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPC subnets).
Experience building and running Docker containers.
Basic knowledge of version control (Git) and automated testing principles.
preferred_skills: Exposure to Kubernetes (k8s) pod management and Helm charts.
Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog monitoring tools.
Basic Python or Go automation scripting.
cultural_competencies: Methodical approach to safety, change control, and failure prevention.
Curiosity for distributed systems and resilience engineering.
Calm demeanor and systematic troubleshooting under pressure.
